item.title: Show HN: TTF-DOOM – A raycaster running inside TrueType font hinting
item.description:
📝 TTF-DOOM A DOOM-style raycaster that runs inside a TrueType font's hinting program. The font file contains a DDA raycasting engine written in TrueType bytecode. Architecture The font just renders walls.
